review: Read-only independent cache, prefetch and lighting source review
findings: Cache keys contact IDs, position, mode, orbit and viewport. Aspect-preserving fallback retains semantic and orbit identity. Different selections cannot substitute cached frames.
Opposite-mode prefetch is bounded by two exact cache entries; empty selections skip prefetch. Input revisions invalidate stale GPU completions before cache publication.
Submitted frame retains model, renderer, texture and output through completion and eager conversion. Mutations are serialized around the in-flight frame. Surface child identity is keyed to the model.
Nil position is a valid cleared selection rather than an error. Runtime key/fill are attached to the coordinator-owned camera; appearance requires actual visual validation.
limitations: During an orbit, presentation intentionally permits the prior completed camera image for the same semantic input until the requested camera render completes.
A speculative alternate-mode render failure currently makes the whole coordinator unavailable, including an existing cached current frame.
Same-aspect resize fallback may temporarily show a lower-resolution completed frame. Initial-frame latency remains a runtime concern.
The four new cache tests exercise a value cache with stand-in values; they do not establish GPU rendering, coordinator lifecycle, visual fidelity or complete workout behavior.
